'''Dermid Ajala''' is a [[blacksmith]] who works at a smithy in the city of [[Tear]].

==Appearance==
He has pale blue eyes and dark hair with almost the same amount of gray as in [[Haral Luhhan|Master Luhhan]]'s. His arms and shoulders are thick, due to years of working metal. He wears baggy breeches and a long leather vest and apron over his bare chest.

==Activities==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] is staying at [[The Star]] inn in [[Tear]], he hears the familiar ring of hammer on anvil from the smithy next door and wanders over. He works the bellows for Ajala, who then gives him a piece of metal stock to try his hand on. Perrin makes a chamfer knife blade, and Ajala is impressed with his technique and offers him a job. Perrin declines, but offers to do some of the apprentice work and spends the rest of the day helping Master Ajala. Ajala declares to [[Faile]] that Perrin's work as good as his "master's piece", and lets Perrin keep a hammer, saying the work he'd completed that day was worth more than a hammer, and that Perrin was "made to hold a smith's hammer".{{ref/book|3|50}}

Later, along with more common work, Ajala has Perrin make a large piece of ornamental work with elaborate curves and scrolls for a country lord's new gate.{{ref/book|3|53}}
